script.text: Here are the rules. This isn't a blackout. Electricity itself has stopped working. No current flows through any wire, anywhere on Earth.
No batteries. No generators. No solar panels. Not even the tiny battery in your watch.
But some things still work. Fire works. Anything with no electric parts works. Bikes. Sailboats. Old steam trains. Your grandpa's wind-up clock.
And here's the weird part. Your brain and your heart run on tiny electrical signals. Those still work. Otherwise this would be a very short video.
So the rule is simple. Anything people built to carry electricity is dead. Every wire, every chip, every screen. Silent. Forever.
Remember that rule. Because one night, far from home, you're going to see it broken.
